meta.title: U.S. poultry, cattle and hog operations
meta.disclaimer: A permitted operation is not by itself proof of contamination. Permitted large operations, documented NPDES enforcement or single-event violations, Iowa DNR listed operations, and USDA disease detections are stored as distinct sub-layers. Living near a listed operation does not necessarily mean a person is at risk.
meta.inventory_gap: EPA does not have a complete national inventory of concentrated animal feeding operations. In 2011 it proposed a CAFO reporting rule; on July 20, 2012 it withdrew that proposal and said it would instead use existing federal, state, and local sources (Federal Register withdrawal; EPA's CAFO regulations page). GAO-08-944 (2008) found that EPA did not have comprehensive, accurate information on the number of permitted CAFOs nationwide. This layer therefore shows NPDES records EPA does publish in ICIS-NPDES, plus official state points where a state posts them (Iowa DNR, and North Carolina, Minnesota, Nebraska, Indiana, Missouri, Pennsylvania, Michigan, Maryland and Texas as separate toggles), and it is not a complete map of U.S. livestock operations.
meta.coordinate_policy: Coordinates are used only when an official dataset publishes them (EPA ICIS-NPDES facility GEOCODE_LATITUDE/GEOCODE_LONGITUDE, Iowa DNR Facilities layer latitude/longitude, or a state agency layer's own published coordinates). This project never geocodes addresses or place names. ICIS coordinates are marked approximate because the public download does not include a collection method. Iowa DNR points whose official collection method is address matching are also marked approximate. Every mapped point was tested against GADM 4.1 United States level-1 boundaries with a 1 km coastal tolerance; failures are withheld from the map and kept as list-only. USDA APHIS HPAI detections have no official farm coordinates and are list-only or county/state shaded, never plotted as points.
